name: Bollywood Party Hits
author: Beatify Team
description: The Hindi film songs a whole room sings along to: Daler Mehndi's Bolo Ta Ra Ra and the K3G wedding numbers, Dostana and Student of the Year, Badshah's party singles and Stree 2's Aaj Ki Raat, from 1995 to 2025. Built for Diwali 2026.

songs.title: Bolo Ta Ra Ra
songs.fun_fact: The title track of Daler Mehndi's 1995 debut album, which made bhangra pop a nationwide craze in India.
songs.fun_fact_de: Titelsong von Daler Mehndis Debütalbum von 1995, das Bhangra-Pop in ganz Indien populär machte.
songs.fun_fact_es: Tema principal del álbum debut de Daler Mehndi de 1995, que puso de moda el bhangra pop en toda la India.
songs.fun_fact_fr: Chanson-titre du premier album de Daler Mehndi en 1995, qui a fait du bhangra pop un phénomène dans toute l'Inde.
songs.fun_fact_nl: Titelnummer van Daler Mehndi's debuutalbum uit 1995, dat bhangrapop in heel India populair maakte.
